description: MioVision Daily Pedestrian Counts is a dataset listed in City of Cambridge open data portal (data.cambridgema.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Cambridge. For vehicle counts, see the main traffic count dataset at This dataset contains daily total pedestrian counts by intersection from MioVision traffic cameras. Counts are daily sums of 15-minute counts by intersection/direction/side. Coverage: Cambridge, Massachusetts. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are pedestrians, transportation. The table has 4 columns. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cambridgema-gov-portal.
